$comment: Plant schemes of the IDM installation manuals (docs/sources/manuals/README.md): the unit, the manual page, the scheme code where the manual prints one, a short title and the IDM tags (Bxx sensors, Mxx actors) drawn in the scheme. Facts only. Used by tools/build-gallery.ts to draw every scheme and by src/lib/diagram/schemes.test.ts. `storage` is what the diagram setting would be for the scheme (separate = a TERMO next to a Hygienik or AQA).
